comments.author: @Dunleap
comments.text:
-flushable wet wipes.
- If you are a man, and do not expect access to Washing machine, take as many t-shirts as days you plan to travel. Go for cotton avoid polyester, when sweaty it smell bad, even taxi driver didn't know that I know what "hôi nách" mean -.- Bring antiperspirant, even in the winter.
- if you don not favour sea food, grab some dry snaks for long car trips, to always have something you like. Food in Vietnam is great, but in some areas they eat stuff that do not look appetizing, after long drive.  
- If going to Hanoi or other big city, and you have a beard. Get yourself a nice face mask that fit you well. Unfortunately, city air is not the best and your nose will be packed with stuff at the end of the day. If you don't like that, get a nice face mask. They sell them everywhere in vietnam, but if you are big head european fiding right size might be harder.
